title: Migrate GC source root
summary: Move CodeWiki garbage-collection types, dry-run/purge logic, restore-ledger writing, and codewiki_gc tool execution into src/gc/**.

goal.outcome: GC ownership lives under src/gc/** with dry-run/purge behavior, restore-ledger policy, and tool execution preserved.
acceptance: Create src/gc/** owner modules for GC tool input types, candidate detection, dry-run/purge execution, restore-ledger writing, and codewiki_gc tool execution.
Update adapters, schemas, tests, and package smoke to import GC behavior from src/gc/** or stable public API paths.
Remove old src/domain/gc/types.ts, src/application/gc.ts, and src/application/tools/gc.ts owner paths or retain only explicit temporary shims with TASK-specific tests.
Preserve codewiki_gc schema/result behavior, archive_sha/tree_sha proof requirements, restore-ledger semantics, package loading, direct Node execution, and existing GC dry-run outputs.
Add TASK-specific guard proving legacy GC imports are gone or explicitly shimmed.
non_goals: Do not migrate project, knowledge, roadmap, session, state/graph/resume, change/diff-table, adapters/UI, or skills.
Do not change GC eligibility policy, restore-ledger schema, destructive purge safety, package metadata, or public command behavior.
verification: codewiki_gc action=dry-run include=tracked,runtime with safe proof where applicable
